propositions: Gate runs do not persist per-run request counts or tool-call counts, making it impossible to distinguish loops from breadth or tune the step budget
The loop-vs-breadth signal is computed by failure_usage() but discarded at the record() write, leaving the data durable only as ephemeral log lines
Local operator gate runs record nothing because REBAR_USAGE_LOG is unset and the default sink was never wired, requiring instrumented re-runs to answer usage questions
The success path never computes or records tool_calls, request_limit, tool_calls_limit, or wall-clock duration, asymmetric with the failure path
This ticket wires the existing mechanism: failure_usage() is aliased run_shape(), called on both paths, and seven computed keys are added to _SHAPE_FIELDS and written by record()
A gate run now appends to .rebar/usage.jsonl by default when in_gate_session() is true, and summarize renders distinct/total tool-call ratios so loops are distinguishable from breadth after the fact
